name: logo_fix
style: This is already the Korean logo; only fix legibility. Problem: the first syllable '케' reads like 'ㅋ' followed by two separate vertical bars, so the word looks like '케ㅣ이온'. Redraw '케' so its vowel 'ㅔ' is unmistakable: a clearly visible short horizontal stroke from the left vertical of ㅔ toward ㅋ, the two verticals of ㅔ close together, and a clearly larger gap between '케' and '이'. Keep the same chunky red letters, cream outline, drop shadow, the 'K-ON!' mark and the guitar inside '온'. Second line: put a clearly visible space between '방과후' and '라이브!!' (move them apart, about one letter width), keep colours green/orange and the music staff decoration. Keep the small white menu text on the right side unchanged.
